targets.rawSql:
SELECT coalesce(sum(r.value_numeric), 0) AS "Steps Today"
FROM health_observations_raw r JOIN health_sources s ON s.id = r.source_id
WHERE r.metric_type = 'steps' AND s.source_system = 'health_connect_direct'
  AND text_to_timestamptz_immutable(r.start_time) >= (date_trunc('day', now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York') AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York')
  AND text_to_timestamptz_immutable(r.start_time) < ((date_trunc('day', now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York') + interval '1 day') AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York')

SELECT r.value_numeric AS "Latest Heart Rate"
FROM health_observations_raw r JOIN health_sources s ON s.id = r.source_id
WHERE r.metric_type = 'heart_rate' AND s.source_system = 'health_connect_direct'
  AND r.unit = 'count/min'
ORDER BY text_to_timestamptz_immutable(r.start_time) DESC LIMIT 1

WITH segments AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT text_to_timestamptz_immutable(r.start_time) AS starts,
         text_to_timestamptz_immutable(r.end_time) AS ends,
         lower(coalesce(r.value_text, 'unknown')) AS stage,
         substring(r.external_id from 'health_connect:[^:]+:sleep:([^:]+):stage:[0-9]+') AS session_uuid
  FROM health_observations_raw r JOIN health_sources s ON s.id = r.source_id
  WHERE r.metric_type = 'sleep_segment'
    AND s.source_system = 'health_connect_direct'
    AND r.external_id ~ '^health_connect:[^:]+:sleep:[^:]+:stage:[0-9]+$'
), sessions AS (
  SELECT session_uuid, min(starts) AS bedtime, max(ends) AS wake,
         sum(extract(epoch FROM (ends - starts))) FILTER (WHERE stage <> 'awake') / 3600.0 AS duration_hours,
         (max(ends) AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York')::date AS wake_date
  FROM segments GROUP BY session_uuid
), ranked AS (
  SELECT *, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY wake_date ORDER BY duration_hours DESC) AS rank_for_day
  FROM sessions
),
filtered AS (
  SELECT r.*
  FROM ranked r
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM ranked r2
    WHERE r2.wake_date = r.wake_date
      AND r2.duration_hours > r.duration_hours
      AND r2.bedtime < r.wake
      AND r2.wake > r.bedtime
  )
)
SELECT coalesce(sum(duration_hours), 0) AS "Sleep Last Night"
FROM filtered
WHERE wake_date = (date_trunc('day', now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York'))::date
  AND rank_for_day = 1

SELECT coalesce(sum(r.value_numeric), 0) AS "Active Energy Today"
FROM health_observations_raw r JOIN health_sources s ON s.id = r.source_id
WHERE r.metric_type = 'active_energy' AND s.source_system = 'health_connect_direct'
  AND r.unit IN ('Cal', 'kcal')
  AND text_to_timestamptz_immutable(r.start_time) >= (date_trunc('day', now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York') AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York')
  AND text_to_timestamptz_immutable(r.start_time) < ((date_trunc('day', now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York') + interval '1 day') AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York')

SELECT r.value_numeric AS "Latest SpO2"
FROM health_observations_raw r JOIN health_sources s ON s.id = r.source_id
WHERE r.metric_type = 'oxygen_saturation' AND s.source_system = 'health_connect_direct'
  AND r.unit = '%'
ORDER BY text_to_timestamptz_immutable(r.start_time) DESC LIMIT 1

WITH hr_data AS (
  SELECT text_to_timestamptz_immutable(r.start_time) AS ts, r.value_numeric AS hr
  FROM health_observations_raw r
  JOIN health_sources s ON s.id = r.source_id
  WHERE r.metric_type = 'heart_rate' AND s.source_system = 'health_connect_direct' AND r.unit = 'count/min'
    AND text_to_timestamptz_immutable(r.start_time) >= $__timeFrom() AND text_to_timestamptz_immutable(r.start_time) <= $__timeTo()
), with_gap AS (
  SELECT ts, hr,
         lag(ts) OVER (ORDER BY ts) AS prev_ts,
         AVG(hr) OVER (ORDER BY ts ROWS BETWEEN 9 PRECEDING AND 9 FOLLOWING) AS moving_avg
  FROM hr_data
), with_nulls AS (
  SELECT ts - interval '1 second' AS "time", NULL::double precision AS "Heart Rate", NULL::double precision AS "10-pt Moving Avg"
  FROM with_gap
  WHERE prev_ts IS NOT NULL AND ts - prev_ts > interval '15 minutes'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT ts AS "time", hr AS "Heart Rate", moving_avg AS "10-pt Moving Avg"
  FROM with_gap
)
SELECT "time", "Heart Rate", "10-pt Moving Avg" FROM with_nulls ORDER BY 1

WITH segments AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT text_to_timestamptz_immutable(r.start_time) AS starts,
         text_to_timestamptz_immutable(r.end_time) AS ends,
         lower(coalesce(r.value_text, 'unknown')) AS stage,
         substring(r.external_id from 'health_connect:[^:]+:sleep:([^:]+):stage:[0-9]+') AS session_uuid
  FROM health_observations_raw r JOIN health_sources s ON s.id = r.source_id
  WHERE r.metric_type = 'sleep_segment'
    AND s.source_system = 'health_connect_direct'
    AND r.external_id ~ '^health_connect:[^:]+:sleep:[^:]+:stage:[0-9]+$'
    AND text_to_timestamptz_immutable(r.start_time) >= now() - interval '24 hours'
), sessions AS (
  SELECT session_uuid,
         sum(extract(epoch FROM (ends - starts))) FILTER (WHERE stage <> 'awake') / 3600.0 AS duration_hours,
         (max(ends) AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York')::date AS wake_date
  FROM segments GROUP BY session_uuid
), ranked AS (
  SELECT *, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY wake_date ORDER BY duration_hours DESC) AS rank_for_day
  FROM sessions
),
filtered AS (
  SELECT r.*
  FROM ranked r
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM ranked r2
    WHERE r2.wake_date = r.wake_date
      AND r2.duration_hours > r.duration_hours
      AND r2.bedtime < r.wake
      AND r2.wake > r.bedtime
  )
)
SELECT seg.starts AS "time",
       seg.ends AS "timeEnd",
       seg.stage AS "Sleep Stage"
FROM segments seg
JOIN filtered r ON seg.session_uuid = r.session_uuid
WHERE r.rank_for_day = 1
ORDER BY 1

WITH recent AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT text_to_timestamptz_immutable(r.start_time) AS observed_at, r.value_numeric
  FROM health_observations_raw r JOIN health_sources s ON s.id = r.source_id
  WHERE r.metric_type = 'steps' AND s.source_system = 'health_connect_direct'
    AND text_to_timestamptz_immutable(r.start_time) >= $__timeFrom()
    AND text_to_timestamptz_immutable(r.start_time) <= $__timeTo()
)
SELECT date_trunc('hour', observed_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York') AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York' AS "time", SUM(value_numeric) AS "Steps"
FROM recent GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH recent AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT text_to_timestamptz_immutable(r.start_time) AS observed_at, r.value_numeric
  FROM health_observations_raw r JOIN health_sources s ON s.id = r.source_id
  WHERE r.metric_type = 'steps' AND s.source_system = 'health_connect_direct'
    AND text_to_timestamptz_immutable(r.start_time) >= $__timeFrom()
    AND text_to_timestamptz_immutable(r.start_time) <= $__timeTo()
), hourly AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('hour', observed_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York') AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York' AS hour, SUM(value_numeric) AS steps
  FROM recent GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT hour AS "time", AVG(steps) OVER (ORDER BY hour ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS "Rolling Avg (3h)" FROM hourly ORDER BY 1

SELECT date_trunc('hour', text_to_timestamptz_immutable(r.start_time)) AS "time",
       SUM(r.value_numeric) AS "Total Calories"
FROM health_observations_raw r
WHERE r.metric_type = 'calories'
  AND text_to_timestamptz_immutable(r.start_time) BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH segments AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT text_to_timestamptz_immutable(r.start_time) AS starts,
         text_to_timestamptz_immutable(r.end_time) AS ends,
         lower(coalesce(r.value_text, 'unknown')) AS stage,
         substring(r.external_id from 'health_connect:[^:]+:sleep:([^:]+):stage:[0-9]+') AS session_uuid
  FROM health_observations_raw r JOIN health_sources s ON s.id = r.source_id
  WHERE r.metric_type = 'sleep_segment'
    AND s.source_system = 'health_connect_direct'
    AND r.external_id ~ '^health_connect:[^:]+:sleep:[^:]+:stage:[0-9]+$'
), sessions AS (
  SELECT session_uuid, min(starts) AS bedtime, max(ends) AS wake,
         sum(extract(epoch FROM (ends - starts))) FILTER (WHERE stage <> 'awake') / 3600.0 AS duration_hours,
         (max(ends) AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York')::date AS wake_date
  FROM segments GROUP BY session_uuid
), ranked AS (
  SELECT *, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY wake_date ORDER BY duration_hours DESC) AS rank_for_day
  FROM sessions
),
filtered AS (
  SELECT r.*
  FROM ranked r
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM ranked r2
    WHERE r2.wake_date = r.wake_date
      AND r2.duration_hours > r.duration_hours
      AND r2.bedtime < r.wake
      AND r2.wake > r.bedtime
  )
)
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN wake_date = (now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York')::date THEN 'Last night'
    WHEN wake_date = (now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York')::date - 1 THEN '1 night ago'
    WHEN wake_date = (now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York')::date - 2 THEN '2 nights ago'
    WHEN wake_date = (now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York')::date - 3 THEN '3 nights ago'
    WHEN wake_date = (now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York')::date - 4 THEN '4 nights ago'
    WHEN wake_date = (now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York')::date - 5 THEN '5 nights ago'
    WHEN wake_date = (now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York')::date - 6 THEN '6 nights ago'
    ELSE to_char(wake_date, 'MM/DD')
  END AS "Night",
  to_char(bedtime AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York', 'HH:MI AM') AS "Bedtime",
  to_char(wake AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York', 'HH:MI AM') AS "Wake",
  round(duration_hours::numeric, 1) AS "Hours",
  CASE WHEN rank_for_day = 1 THEN 'Sleep' ELSE 'Nap' END AS "Type"
FROM filtered
ORDER BY wake DESC LIMIT 10

WITH segments AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT text_to_timestamptz_immutable(r.start_time) AS starts,
         text_to_timestamptz_immutable(r.end_time) AS ends,
         lower(coalesce(r.value_text, 'unknown')) AS stage,
         substring(r.external_id from 'health_connect:[^:]+:sleep:([^:]+):stage:[0-9]+') AS session_uuid
  FROM health_observations_raw r JOIN health_sources s ON s.id = r.source_id
  WHERE r.metric_type = 'sleep_segment'
    AND s.source_system = 'health_connect_direct'
    AND r.external_id ~ '^health_connect:[^:]+:sleep:[^:]+:stage:[0-9]+$'
), sessions AS (
  SELECT session_uuid, min(starts) AS bedtime, max(ends) AS wake,
         sum(extract(epoch FROM (ends - starts))) FILTER (WHERE stage <> 'awake') / 3600.0 AS duration_hours,
         (max(ends) AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York')::date AS wake_date
  FROM segments GROUP BY session_uuid
), ranked AS (
  SELECT *, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY wake_date ORDER BY duration_hours DESC) AS rank_for_day
  FROM sessions
),
filtered AS (
  SELECT r.*
  FROM ranked r
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM ranked r2
    WHERE r2.wake_date = r.wake_date
      AND r2.duration_hours > r.duration_hours
      AND r2.bedtime < r.wake
      AND r2.wake > r.bedtime
  )
)
SELECT (wake_date::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York') AS "time", duration_hours AS "Sleep hours"
FROM filtered
WHERE rank_for_day = 1 AND wake_date >= (current_date - 13)
ORDER BY wake_date

WITH segments AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT text_to_timestamptz_immutable(r.start_time) AS starts,
         text_to_timestamptz_immutable(r.end_time) AS ends,
         lower(coalesce(r.value_text, 'unknown')) AS stage,
         substring(r.external_id from 'health_connect:[^:]+:sleep:([^:]+):stage:[0-9]+') AS session_uuid
  FROM health_observations_raw r JOIN health_sources s ON s.id = r.source_id
  WHERE r.metric_type = 'sleep_segment'
    AND s.source_system = 'health_connect_direct'
    AND r.external_id ~ '^health_connect:[^:]+:sleep:[^:]+:stage:[0-9]+$'
), sessions AS (
  SELECT session_uuid, min(starts) AS bedtime, max(ends) AS wake,
         sum(extract(epoch FROM (ends - starts))) FILTER (WHERE stage <> 'awake') / 3600.0 AS duration_hours,
         (max(ends) AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York')::date AS wake_date
  FROM segments GROUP BY session_uuid
), ranked AS (
  SELECT *, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY wake_date ORDER BY duration_hours DESC) AS rank_for_day
  FROM sessions
),
filtered AS (
  SELECT r.*
  FROM ranked r
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM ranked r2
    WHERE r2.wake_date = r.wake_date
      AND r2.duration_hours > r.duration_hours
      AND r2.bedtime < r.wake
      AND r2.wake > r.bedtime
  )
),
nights AS (
  SELECT wake_date, duration_hours
  FROM filtered
  WHERE rank_for_day = 1 AND wake_date >= (current_date - 13)
)
SELECT (wake_date::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York') AS "time",
       AVG(duration_hours) OVER (ORDER BY wake_date ROWS BETWEEN 13 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS "Avg (14 nights)"
FROM nights
ORDER BY wake_date

WITH base AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT text_to_timestamptz_immutable(r.start_time) AS starts,
         text_to_timestamptz_immutable(r.end_time) AS ends, lower(r.value_text) AS stage
  FROM health_observations_raw r JOIN health_sources s ON s.id = r.source_id
  WHERE r.metric_type = 'sleep_segment' AND s.source_system = 'health_connect_direct'
    AND lower(r.value_text) IN ('light', 'deep', 'rem', 'awake')
    AND text_to_timestamptz_immutable(r.start_time) >= now() - interval '14 days'
), marked AS (
  SELECT *, CASE WHEN starts > lag(ends) OVER (ORDER BY starts, ends) + interval '30 minutes'
                     OR lag(ends) OVER (ORDER BY starts, ends) IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS new_session
  FROM base
), segmented AS (
  SELECT *, sum(new_session) OVER (ORDER BY starts, ends) AS session_id FROM marked
), sessions AS (
  SELECT session_id, min(starts) AS bedtime, max(ends) AS wake, (max(ends) AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York')::date AS wake_date,
         sum(extract(epoch FROM (ends - starts))) FILTER (WHERE stage <> 'awake') AS asleep_seconds
  FROM segmented GROUP BY session_id
), ranked AS (
  SELECT *, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY wake_date ORDER BY asleep_seconds DESC) AS rank_for_day
  FROM sessions
),
filtered AS (
  SELECT r.*
  FROM ranked r
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM ranked r2
    WHERE r2.wake_date = r.wake_date
      AND r2.asleep_seconds > r.asleep_seconds
      AND r2.bedtime < r.wake
      AND r2.wake > r.bedtime
  )
)
SELECT (r.wake_date::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York') AS "time",
  sum(extract(epoch FROM (s.ends-s.starts))) FILTER (WHERE s.stage='light') / 3600.0 AS "Light",
  sum(extract(epoch FROM (s.ends-s.starts))) FILTER (WHERE s.stage='deep') / 3600.0 AS "Deep",
  sum(extract(epoch FROM (s.ends-s.starts))) FILTER (WHERE s.stage='rem') / 3600.0 AS "REM",
  sum(extract(epoch FROM (s.ends-s.starts))) FILTER (WHERE s.stage='awake') / 3600.0 AS "Awake"
FROM segmented s JOIN filtered r USING (session_id)
WHERE r.rank_for_day = 1 AND r.wake_date >= current_date - 13
GROUP BY r.wake_date ORDER BY 1

WITH recent AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT text_to_timestamptz_immutable(r.start_time) AS observed_at, r.value_numeric
  FROM health_observations_raw r JOIN health_sources s ON s.id=r.source_id
  WHERE r.metric_type='steps' AND s.source_system = 'health_connect_direct' AND text_to_timestamptz_immutable(r.start_time) >= ($__timeFrom())::timestamptz-interval '6 days' AND text_to_timestamptz_immutable(r.start_time) <= ($__timeTo())::timestamptz
), daily AS (
  SELECT (observed_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York')::date AS day, SUM(value_numeric) AS steps FROM recent GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT (day::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York') AS "time", steps AS "Steps", AVG(steps) OVER (ORDER BY day ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS "7d Avg" FROM daily WHERE day >= (($__timeFrom())::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York')::date ORDER BY day

WITH recent AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT text_to_timestamptz_immutable(r.start_time) AS observed_at, r.value_numeric
  FROM health_observations_raw r JOIN health_sources s ON s.id=r.source_id
  WHERE r.metric_type='steps' AND s.source_system = 'health_connect_direct' AND text_to_timestamptz_immutable(r.start_time) >= ($__timeFrom())::timestamptz-interval '6 days' AND text_to_timestamptz_immutable(r.start_time) <= ($__timeTo())::timestamptz
), daily AS (
  SELECT (observed_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York')::date AS day, SUM(value_numeric) AS steps FROM recent GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT (date_trunc('week', day::timestamp) AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York') AS "time", SUM(steps) AS "Steps" FROM daily GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT date_trunc('day', text_to_timestamptz_immutable(r.start_time) AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York') AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York' AS "time",
       sum(r.value_numeric) AS "Active Energy"
FROM health_observations_raw r JOIN health_sources s ON s.id = r.source_id
WHERE r.metric_type = 'active_energy' AND s.source_system = 'health_connect_direct'
  AND r.unit IN ('Cal', 'kcal') AND text_to_timestamptz_immutable(r.start_time) >= now() - interval '30 days'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT date_trunc('day', text_to_timestamptz_immutable(r.start_time) AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York') AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York' AS "time",
       sum(r.value_numeric) / 1000.0 AS "Distance (km)"
FROM health_observations_raw r JOIN health_sources s ON s.id = r.source_id
WHERE r.metric_type = 'distance' AND s.source_system = 'health_connect_direct'
  AND r.unit = 'm' AND text_to_timestamptz_immutable(r.start_time) >= now() - interval '30 days'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH daily AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('day', text_to_timestamptz_immutable(r.start_time) AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York')::date AS day,
         SUM(r.value_numeric) AS steps
  FROM health_observations_raw r
  JOIN health_sources s ON s.id = r.source_id
  WHERE r.metric_type = 'steps'
    AND s.source_system IN ($source_system)
    AND r.value_numeric IS NOT NULL
    AND text_to_timestamptz_immutable(r.start_time) >= $__timeFrom()
    AND text_to_timestamptz_immutable(r.start_time) <= $__timeTo()
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT (day::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York') AS "time",
       steps AS "Steps",
       AVG(steps) OVER (ORDER BY day ROWS BETWEEN 29 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS "30d Avg"
FROM daily
ORDER BY day

SELECT date_trunc('day', text_to_timestamptz_immutable(r.start_time) AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York') AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York' AS "time",
       AVG(r.value_numeric) AS "Resting HR"
FROM health_observations_raw r
JOIN health_sources s ON s.id = r.source_id
WHERE r.metric_type = 'resting_heart_rate'
  AND s.source_system IN ($source_system)
  AND r.value_numeric IS NOT NULL
  AND text_to_timestamptz_immutable(r.start_time) >= $__timeFrom()
  AND text_to_timestamptz_immutable(r.start_time) <= $__timeTo()
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT text_to_timestamptz_immutable(r.start_time) AS "time",
       r.value_numeric AS "Weight"
FROM health_observations_raw r
JOIN health_sources s ON s.id = r.source_id
WHERE r.metric_type = 'weight'
  AND s.source_system IN ($source_system)
  AND r.value_numeric IS NOT NULL
  AND text_to_timestamptz_immutable(r.start_time) >= $__timeFrom()
  AND text_to_timestamptz_immutable(r.start_time) <= $__timeTo()
ORDER BY 1

SELECT date_trunc('day', text_to_timestamptz_immutable(r.start_time) AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York') AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York' AS "time",
       MIN(r.value_numeric) AS "Min HR",
       AVG(r.value_numeric) AS "Avg HR",
       MAX(r.value_numeric) AS "Max HR"
FROM health_observations_raw r
JOIN health_sources s ON s.id = r.source_id
WHERE r.metric_type = 'heart_rate'
  AND s.source_system IN ($source_system)
  AND r.value_numeric IS NOT NULL
  AND text_to_timestamptz_immutable(r.start_time) >= $__timeFrom()
  AND text_to_timestamptz_immutable(r.start_time) <= $__timeTo()
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT date_trunc('day', text_to_timestamptz_immutable(r.start_time) AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York') AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York' AS "time",
       SUM(r.value_numeric) AS "Active Energy"
FROM health_observations_raw r
JOIN health_sources s ON s.id = r.source_id
WHERE r.metric_type = 'active_energy'
  AND s.source_system IN ($source_system)
  AND r.value_numeric IS NOT NULL
  AND text_to_timestamptz_immutable(r.start_time) >= $__timeFrom()
  AND text_to_timestamptz_immutable(r.start_time) <= $__timeTo()
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT date_trunc('day', text_to_timestamptz_immutable(r.start_time) AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York') AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York' AS "time",
       SUM(r.value_numeric) / 1000.0 AS "Distance (km)"
FROM health_observations_raw r
JOIN health_sources s ON s.id = r.source_id
WHERE r.metric_type = 'distance'
  AND s.source_system IN ($source_system)
  AND r.value_numeric IS NOT NULL
  AND text_to_timestamptz_immutable(r.start_time) >= $__timeFrom()
  AND text_to_timestamptz_immutable(r.start_time) <= $__timeTo()
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH segments AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT text_to_timestamptz_immutable(r.start_time) AS seg_start,
         text_to_timestamptz_immutable(r.end_time) AS seg_end,
         lower(coalesce(r.value_text, 'unknown')) AS stage,
         substring(r.external_id from 'health_connect:[^:]+:sleep:([^:]+):stage:[0-9]+') AS session_uuid
  FROM health_observations_raw r
  JOIN health_sources s ON s.id = r.source_id
  WHERE r.metric_type = 'sleep_segment'
    AND s.source_system IN ($source_system)
    AND r.external_id ~ '^health_connect:[^:]+:sleep:[^:]+:stage:[0-9]+$'
    AND text_to_timestamptz_immutable(r.start_time) >= $__timeFrom()
    AND text_to_timestamptz_immutable(r.start_time) <= $__timeTo()
), sessions AS (
  SELECT session_uuid,
         min(seg_start) AS bedtime,
         max(seg_end) AS wake,
         (max(seg_end) AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York')::date AS wake_date
  FROM segments GROUP BY session_uuid
), ranked AS (
  SELECT session_uuid, wake_date,
         (wake - bedtime) AS session_len,
         row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY wake_date ORDER BY (wake - bedtime) DESC) AS rank_for_day
  FROM sessions
), primary_sessions AS (
  SELECT session_uuid, wake_date FROM filtered WHERE rank_for_day = 1
), stage_hours AS (
  SELECT ps.wake_date,
         seg.stage,
         COALESCE(sum(extract(epoch FROM (seg.seg_end - seg.seg_start))) / 3600.0, 0) AS hours
  FROM primary_sessions ps
  JOIN segments seg USING (session_uuid)
  GROUP BY ps.wake_date, seg.stage
),
filtered AS (
  SELECT r.*
  FROM ranked r
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM ranked r2
    WHERE r2.wake_date = r.wake_date
      AND r2.session_len > r.session_len
      AND r2.bedtime < r.wake
      AND r2.wake > r.bedtime
  )
)
SELECT (wake_date::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York') AS "time",
       MAX(hours) FILTER (WHERE stage = 'deep')  AS "Deep",
       MAX(hours) FILTER (WHERE stage = 'rem')   AS "REM",
       MAX(hours) FILTER (WHERE stage = 'light') AS "Light",
       MAX(hours) FILTER (WHERE stage = 'awake') AS "Awake"
FROM stage_hours
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT text_to_timestamptz_immutable(r.start_time) AS "time",
       CASE WHEN r.value_numeric IS NOT NULL THEN r.value_numeric
            ELSE NULL END AS "$metric",
       r.value_text,
       s.source_system AS "source"
FROM health_observations_raw r
JOIN health_sources s ON s.id = r.source_id
WHERE r.metric_type = '$metric'
  AND s.source_system IN ($source_system)
  AND text_to_timestamptz_immutable(r.start_time) BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
ORDER BY 1
